question: “If you sniff my scent, a corpse appears.(I’m not saying that the person he smells gets killed)” It’s well-known that Subaru has this type of stinky scent, but what kind of stinky scent is it? I can imagine it being the type of smell that you would have on your shoes after walking in heavy rain, but is that about it? What would Rem think of Subaru if he smelled like that year after year? Would she come up with a “the extreme bitterness of this coffee is what makes it delicious” sort of theory? Or perhaps the power of love?
answer: The power of love. Rem would sniff Subaru to point that she wouldn’t even care very much about her own smell.
